card.name: Linking words before African place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as near, to, of and in that come right before an African place name (Namibia, Tanzania, Kenya, Zimbabwe). Weaker hits appear on digits in numbers.

modes.label: Preposition before place
modes.description: A preposition such as near, to, of or in sits just before a southern or eastern African place name.
modes.example: Quiver Tree Forest<< near>> Keetmanshoop, Namibia

modes.label: Stray number and word pieces
modes.description: Occasional hits on a decimal point or digit in dose and table numbers, or on the middle of a medical word.

card.plain: It fires on little words like near or of just before the name of a place in Africa, such as Namibia or Tanzania.
